treatment_suggestions.title: Administer Paracetamol for Fever Control
treatment_suggestions.rationale: To reduce fever and prevent complications from high temperature, which is critical in managing febrile seizures and preventing further episodes.

treatment_suggestions.title: Continuous Monitoring During Transport
treatment_suggestions.rationale: To ensure the patient remains stable and to detect any signs of complications such as prolonged seizure activity or respiratory distress during transit.

treatment_suggestions.title: Transport to Pediatric Emergency Department
treatment_suggestions.rationale: For further evaluation to rule out underlying infections, meningitis, or other serious conditions that may require hospitalization.

drafted_journal: Situation: Febrile seizure. Bakgrund: 21-årig pojke. Plötslig debut av feber och kramp. Socialt: Ingen känd tidigare sjukdom. Aktuellt: Vaken vid vår ankomst. a: Fritt. b: Rena andningsljud, saturation 100 %. c: Blodtryck 120/75, regelbunden puls. d: AKUT test: Alert, men trött. Åtgärd: Ger Alvedon (paracetamol) för feberkontroll. e: Temp 40°C, inga andra symtom. Prehospitalt bedömt tillstånd: Feberkramp, behov av vidare utredning. Rekommendation: Till barnakuten på Huddinge för vidare vård. Under transport: Kontinuerlig övervakning, god effekt av paracetamol.
